short: Hybrid Integration of Silicon Photonic Devices on Lithium Ni
title: Hybrid Integration of Silicon Photonic Devices on Lithium Niobate for Optomechanical Wavelength Conversion

lanes.label: Classical tools
lanes.sub: collapsed to one node per state

states.title: Hypothesis and design
states.head: Homogeneous thin-film LiNbO3 microwave-to-optical transducers lack the optomechanical coupling needed for efficient quantum transduction. Placing a high-index Si photonic crystal cavity on a piezoelectric LiNbO3 resonator should raise optomechanical coupling while keeping piezoelectric coupling.
states.detail: Absorbed: n1 (HYP/need), n2 (HYP/hypothesis), n3 (DES/route), n4 (DES/architecture), n5 (DES/base_system), n6 (PRC/forming), n24 (PRC/forming), n7 (PRC/joining). Premises: LiNbO3 has large piezoelectric coefficients but a low refractive index (~2.2 at 1550 nm); Tapered optical fibres couple light into nanophotonic devices with high efficiency; Tapered fibres have ripped loosely tethered photonic crystal cavities off the chip they were made on

states.title: Structure state
states.head: Si nanobeam rests on the released LN membrane beside and parallel to the IDT fingers, its tapered waveguide running past the membrane edge

states.title: Property state and mechanisms
states.head: High-index Si confines the optical mode in the nanobeam above the LN, where the membrane strain modulates it, raising optomechanical coupling over LN alone. The slapped hybrid cavity resonates at 1588.5 nm with optical Q 2.86x10^4 (linewidth 6.6 GHz), plus a second resonance near 1617 nm.
states.detail: Absorbed: n12 (MEC/pathway), n13 (PRP/value), n14 (PRP/value), n15 (PRP/value). Premises: g0 extraction from S21 in the sideband-resolved regime (ref 19) with R_load = 50 Ohm and photodiode responsivity 1300 V/W

states.title: Performance state
states.head: The slapped Si-on-LiNbO3 device transduces microwave to optical signals at room temperature, with S21 maximal at the ~1.7 GHz mechanical mode. Photon-number conversion efficiency eta ~1x10^-7 at 25 uW optical power in the fibre
states.detail: Absorbed: n16 (PRF/service_capability), n17 (PRF/figure_of_merit). Premises: eta = C0 * n_cav * eta_ext,mu * eta_ext,o

states.title: Conclusion
states.head: Fibre-based slapping gives a simple, material-independent route to nanoscale-aligned hybrid photonic devices, shown by a working Si-on-LiNbO3 microwave-to-optical transducer
